skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Select a legal issue directly related to the internship unit's activities.
Gain a comprehensive understanding of the internship unit's operations and the application of laws.
Apply research methodologies to analyze legal issues and propose solutions.
Critically analyze legal issues and their applications in real-world scenarios.
Effectively communicate findings through written reports and presentations.
Develop independent research skills and the ability to self-study and accumulate specialized knowledge.
Propose solutions to legal problems with ethical considerations.
Adhere to rules and regulations of the organization and understand responsibilities.
Smoothly operate in a team environment.
Manage time effectively and logically solve problems.
Demonstrate professional ethics as a lawyer.
Review and analyze legal documents for accuracy and relevance.
Evaluate the application of laws in practical settings.
Formulate logical arguments and present them effectively.
